CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, with the ticker CCC and a CIK of 0001818201. The website associated with the company in this record is calgoncarbon.com, which describes Calgon Carbon as a leader in air and water purification using activated carbon. The site presents FILTRASORB, described as a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon proven over more than 40 years in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings. The site says FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The harvested site material does not describe any AI products or services, and no products are tracked for the company in this record. The site content centers on activated carbon and water and air purification rather than artificial intelligence.

Among the facts held, the company has no recorded lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its recorded law exposure is in Illinois, with a count of 375.
